**De praktiserende speciallæger (Enheden for Kvalitet I Speciallægepraksis)**, commonly referred to as **eKVIS**, is a professional unit representing practicing medical specialists in Denmark. Within the Danish healthcare system's quality management infrastructure, eKVIS serves as a key stakeholder and reviewing body for national clinical quality reports.

Specifically, the organization participates in the review process for [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]], the annual report published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) that documents and assesses the quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across the country. As part of the report's quality assurance mechanism, eKVIS—alongside the five Danish regions—is invited to submit formal comments on the clinical quality indicators, statistical methodologies, and data registrations presented in the annual editions [^src1] [^src2]. 

In the 2024 edition of the report, eKVIS was listed among the reviewing entities but submitted no comments ("Ingen kommentarer") regarding the indicators [^src1]. This pattern continued in the 2025 edition, where the report explicitly noted that no comments were received from the practicing specialists ("Ikke modtaget kommentarer") [^src2]. The consistent absence of formal objections or remarks from eKVIS and other major stakeholders suggests either a broad consensus with the reported data and indicator definitions, or a lack of specific administrative feedback for those particular annual editions [^src1] [^src2].
